answer: Agents register through TPM/SGX enclaves producing zero-knowledge attestations; the river state tree commits identity keys, gale hash anchors attestations, and the horizon consensus contract accepts only fresh proofs. Forging an identity requires physically provisioning distinct certified silicon or compromising an enclave and recomputing its proof. Each identity follows an O(N^2) quadratic bond, with invalid proofs triggering irreversible collateral slashing.
